body: Still open when AUDIT.md was retired (6 Nov 2026; the file is now the frozen section `audit` of docs/history/reviews-2026-10-31.md): F33: **A tap plays a 30-second snippet, not the song** ("which makes the app unusable") || *Cause read in the code, not reproduced on his phone.* A song row is playable when `instant |  | previewUrl != null`; **when the instant-play backend is not there, a tap starts a 30-second Deezer preview (`playPreviewRun`) without a word** (only search rows say "(preview)"). The backend is missing (a) in the **old mode that a fresh sign-in stays in for about two minutes (F30)**, which is exactly a new person's first use, and (b) while it is still loading. He used build 120 (the same two-minute wait) | **Blocker. Merged in #52 (2026-10-30), built, not walked (J13).** Never a silent snippet: while the backend is not ready a tap waits for it and then plays the full song (or says in words why it cannot); a preview only on an explicit long-press, labelled; F30's fix (#47) shortens (a) to seconds. Then walked at a cold start, tapping at once
